headline: Sensex surges over 1,000 points and Nifty tops 25,300 on strong FII inflows and positive Q2 results

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism driven by foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows into Indian equities.
Lower crude oil prices helped boost broad market sentiment.
Positive Q2 financial results lifted investor confidence.
Strong buying momentum led by financial and auto sector stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,000 points, approaching the 82,000 mark.
Nifty 50 crossed the 25,300 level, touching an 8-month high.
Investors gained approximately ₹4.5 lakh crore in market capitalization shortly after market opening.
Fairfax Financial is reportedly looking to exit its investment in IIFL Finance.
summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a massive rally with the Sensex jumping over 1,000 points and Nifty climbing above 25,300. The bullish sentiment was driven by strong foreign institutional investor inflows, positive Q2 corporate earnings, and declining crude oil prices. Financial and auto sector stocks spearheaded the market gains.
